user_instruction: After completing these checks, run initial Gemini trajectories using Harbor. Record rewards, individual verifier results, execution time, steps, token consumption, errors and scientific failure reasons.
scope: One initial diagnostic valid trajectory per Biology task, same Gemini model/scaffold/settings, serial execution; bounded infrastructure retries do not count as scientific failures.
task_requirements: Preserve scientifically valid requirements and frozen validated task versions. No changes merely to force model failure.
storage: New task files, trajectories, reports, tmp and configurable host caches on F wherever practical. Existing installed tools and Docker Desktop storage may remain on C.
provider_policy: Select Gemini model with documented public free tier; do not upgrade billing or switch to a paid-only provider/model. Project invoice/tier is not inferred from a configured key.
